messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — INC8421 — inference-serving-prod request-queue length high (11k+). Autoscaler lagging. Check: https://pagerduty.example/INC8421
pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: INC8421 fired and escalated to on-call
Alex: acked, on it. triaging now.
Alex: quick snapshot: queue length 11,324, 95p latency 3.2s (baseline ~200ms). Error rate ~0.3% — some customer timeouts reported.
Tori: any recent deploys? I saw a batch-optimizer rollout last night.
Alex: checking deploys... release/opt-2026-03-15 @ 01:05 UTC. Autoscaler metrics look like "scaleBehind" for ~14m.
Alex: metrics dump:
```
inference/request_queue_length = 11324
k8s_autoscaler_pending_pod_count = 42
k8s_autoscaler_scaledown_blocked = true
hpa/target_metric = "cpu/request" # expected "cpu/traffic"
```
Maya: heads up — I'm reachable but leaving in ~30m. Can assist with manual scale if needed.
Alex: suspect autoscaler misconfigured metric name in the last release (hpa reading wrong metric). I'm going to try a manual scale to relieve backlog.
Alex: running: `kubectl -n inference-prod scale deployment/inference-pool --replicas=30`
incident-bot: action log: user alex executed redwoodctl scale --pool inference-prod --replicas 30
Alex: output: `Scaled deployment/inference-pool from 8 to 30` — pods are scheduling.
Tori: can we also toggle a traffic split to smaller/quant models to reduce token cost transiently?
Alex: initiating traffic split: `redwoodctl rollout --service inference --split 80:baseline,20:small-quant`
pagerduty: INC8421 acknowledged by Alex (ack at 175888, time recorded).
Raj: taking handoff from Alex — I'm oncall now. Checking cluster state.
Raj: node pressure on gpu-nodes and cloud GPU quota at ~92% usage, might hit quota if we overscale.
Raj: recommendation:
- bump HPA minReplicas -> 20 to keep baseline higher
- request temporary quota bump from cloud infra
- enable prefix/KV caching TTL 60s to reduce duplicate work
Alex: patching HPA minReplicas -> 20: `kubectl patch hpa/inference-pool -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":20}}'`
Alex: patched. HPA reports minReplicas=20 now.
Maya: quota request open: infra@cloud ticket TKT-4412 created, request: +10 GPUs, note: urgent for incident.
Maya: ETA from infra ~15m.
Alex: queue length trend: 11.3k -> 6.8k -> 1.2k over next 9m after manual scale + traffic split.
Raj: confirmed queue < 1k. 95p latency down to ~720ms. Error spikes resolved.
Alex: customer impact: elevated latency and some timeouts for large-model requests; most traffic affected was for customers using the "large" model. Support notified top accounts A, B.
Tori: adding runbook note and initial incident summary to runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/autoscale-queue — noted HPA metric-name mismatch as probable root cause.
Raj: creating follow-up issue for config validation and CI canaries (ISS-2784).
Alex: :thumbsup: closing pager — marking INC8421 resolved.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC8421 resolved by Alex (automation log).
Maya: retrospective actions: add HPA metric-name check to deployment CI, add a small-scale canary that validates autoscaler observability, and add a dashboard alert for HPA target drift.
Raj: I'll stay on for an hour to watch for reoccurrence and coordinate the postmortem.
Alex: handing off to morning oncall for postmortem write-up.
Maya: thanks all — nice quick ops work. :heart:
Raj: summary: manual scale + traffic split + HPA min bump relieved the queue. Root cause likely config change in last release that renamed the HPA metric key. Follow-ups: ISS-2784, TKT-4412 (quota), runbook updates.
Alex: closing thread, will post concise postmortem draft in #postmortems later today.
